subject: MAP draft & pricing approval Stellarsys
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Cortez <elena@stellarsys.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up + MAP draft (next steps & target close)

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the call today. Per our discussion, attaching the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for Stellarsys. Key points from the call:

- Target close: 2026-07-15 (customer wants production pilot in Q3)
- High-level milestones:
  1) PO + contract execution: owner = Stellarsys Procurement, target = 2026-07-15
  2) Onboarding + technical kickoff: owner = Redwood Solutions (Marissa/Marcus), target = 2026-07-22
  3) Pilot validation (perf + cost targets): owner = Stellarsys Eng + Redwood SRE, target = 2026-08-05
  4) Production go-live: owner = Stellarsys Eng, target = 2026-09-01
- Dependencies: SOC 2 evidence for data handling (we provided SOC 2 Type II report earlier), network peering window with their infra team (Elena to confirm), agreed commit level for Dedicated capacity (affects discounts/credits)
- Open ask: Stellarsys requested an initial discount / onboarding credits to accelerate the pilot adoption; they indicated procurement will need exec-level approval if the discount > 15% or credits > $25k.

Next steps on our side:
1) Please review the attached MAP and mark any changes to owners or dates.
2) We will request internal pricing/exec approval for the discount + credits that match the commit level you expect.
3) If you can confirm the commit band (annual $/GPU equivalent) we can lock the pricing.

Attachment: Stellarsys_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Elena Cortez <elena@stellarsys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up + MAP draft (next steps & target close)

Thanks Marissa — this looks good and aligns with what we discussed. A couple of notes from procurement/finance:

- We would like to request a 20% first-year discount and $50k in onboarding credits tied to pilot success (milestone 3). Finance said anything over 15% or credits > $25k needs exec sign-off.
- We can commit to a target annual spend of ~$1.4M if the pilot results meet our perf/cost goals.
- For the network peering window, our infra lead suggested 2 weeks starting 06/29; we will confirm by EOD Friday.

Can you start the pricing/exec approval process on your side? If you can get a proposed pricing redline turned around this week, I can loop in procurement for a quick review.

Thanks,
Elena
Director of Product Operations | Stellarsys
elena@stellarsys.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: FWD: Stellarsys ask — pricing + credits (need exec approval)

Team — forwarding Stellarsys' request from the call. Highlights: 20% first-year discount + $50k onboarding credits (pilot-tied). They signaled a $1.4M annual commit if pilot meets SLAs. Procurement will require exec approval for >15% or >$25k credits.

Attachment: pricing-redline-v1.docx (proposed terms)

Proposed recommendation from AE: approve 20% first-year discount and $50k onboarding credits if they sign a 12-month commit >= $1.2M (we can tier credits by commit band). If commit < $1.2M, propose 15% + $30k credits.

Why: the account is strategic for our healthcare integrations roadmap and will provide reference workload patterns that help Optimize tooling.

Can you advise on:
- Rafael: quick thumbs on approving the 20% + $50k contingent on commit >= $1.2M?
- Neha: any compliance/contract flags for the credit language (pilot milestone tie)?
- Marcus: confirm estimated SRE onboarding effort to size the credits vs effort.

Thanks — looping Rafael for exec sign-off path.

Marissa
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FWD: Stellarsys ask — pricing + credits (need exec approval)

Marissa — thanks for the summary and recommendation. I agree with approving the 20% first-year discount and $50k onboarding credits conditional on a minimum 12-month commit of $1.2M. If the commit is below $1.2M, approve 15% + $30k credits.

Please make the credit schedule explicit in the MAP (milestone 3 = payment of credits on pilot validation) and add a clause that credits expire if the contract is terminated within 6 months.

Neha — flagging for contract language and finance coordination. Marcus — please quantify onboarding SRE hours; if we need to exceed $50k equivalent in delivery, escalate back to me.

Rafael
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference

Subject: Updated MAP + pricing — request for confirmation and next steps

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the quick feedback. Per internal review, here's the agreed proposal for the MAP and pricing path:

- Pricing proposal (conditional):
  • If annual commit >= $1.2M: 20% first-year discount + $50k onboarding credits (applied after pilot validation milestone).
  • If annual commit < $1.2M: 15% first-year discount + $30k onboarding credits.
- Credits: applied as one-time invoice credit after milestone 3 (pilot validation). Credits expire if contract is terminated within 6 months.
- Exec approval: Rafael has approved the above bands; procurement-level approvals are still needed on your side.
- MAP updates: adjusted target close to 2026-07-15 and explicitly lists credit milestone and owners. Attachment updated: pricing-redline-v2.docx and updated MAP in-line (see attached file).

Next steps:
1) Please confirm which commit band Stellarsys expects (>= $1.2M or < $1.2M) so we can prepare the final redline.
2) If you sign off on the >= $1.2M band, we will send a DocuSign for signature (link below) and loop finance for credit issuance.
3) Confirm network peering window (suggested 06/29 start).

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/STELL-4872
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4872

Attachment: pricing-redline-v2.docx
